name: donestate
description: Proof & State's authorised execution plane for AI Work Accountability, with independent OpsTruth verification handoff.

interface.longDescription: DoneState is Proof & State's authorised execution plane in the AI Work Accountability category. Describe a repository outcome, explicitly approve one bounded consequence envelope, and let DoneState run, validate and publish within that authority. OpsTruth is the independent read-only verification plane; DoneState never treats its own execution evidence as proof.
defaultPrompt: Implement this issue within my approved authority and prepare it for independent verification.
Show me the state of my DoneState run.
